preconditions.description: The input integer k must be between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the number of vertices n, followed by n lines representing the adjacency matrix.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == n for row in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) and all(c in 'NY' for row in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for c in row)
postconditions.description: Each row of the adjacency matrix must have exactly n characters, and each character must be either 'N' or 'Y'.

postconditions.expression: any(stdout.splitlines()[1][i] == 'Y' for i in range(n)) and any(stdout.splitlines()[1][j] == 'Y' for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: There must be at least one path between vertex 1 and vertex 2, indicated by 'Y' in the adjacency matrix.
